title: Friends on the Roof
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Jesus was teaching in a packed house. Nobody else could get in the door.
Four men carried their friend, who could not walk, on a mat. They believed Jesus could heal him. But the crowd was in the way.
So the friends climbed up onto the flat roof. They opened it and lowered their friend right down to Jesus!
p2: Jesus saw how much they believed. He said the man’s sins, the wrong things he had done, were forgiven. Some leaders grumbled, “Only Heavenly Father can forgive sins!” So Jesus showed His power. He said, “Get up, take your mat, and go home.” The man walked home, praising Heavenly Father!
Those friends did not give up. Tonight, plan one kind thing to help a friend.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
